name_reason: Name already follows convention data_fd2_<domain>_<descriptor>: prefix data_fd2_ (game global), domain animation, descriptor spell_frame_count_table reflects both content (per-spell total animation frame count) and data type (table/array). No Ghidra address residue. Accurately describes purpose.
purpose: Per-spell total animation frame count: the outer frame-loop bound (how many frames the per-target spell-impact effect plays) for fd2_animate_spell_impact_per_target.
logic_summary: Second of three parallel 33-byte per-spell parameter tables (sprite_offset_table @ 0x51F33, frame_count_table @ 0x51F54, sfx_frame_table @ 0x51F75). Sole reader fd2_animate_spell_impact_per_target (@ 0x1C4CC) copies all 33 bytes to a stack scratch via REP MOVSD x8 + MOVSB (@ 0x1C4F5), then MOVZX byte ptr[ESP+spell_id] (@ 0x1C66F) loads the count and CMP uses it as the animation frame loop bound. Indexed by spell_id (0x00..0x20, 33 entries).
element_semantics: One unsigned byte per spell_id; value = total number of animation frames the spell-impact effect plays for that spell. Proven uint8 by the byte-wide MOVZX load (stride 1, zero-extended) and the 33-byte REP MOVSD+MOVSB copy extent; the DWORD copy granularity is a memcpy optimisation, not a 4-byte element stride. Boundary fixed: next table data_fd2_animation_spell_sfx_frame_table begins exactly at +33 (0x51F75).
